applies_why: The judge text marks the Luke 2:48-49 single-verse exchange UNDERDETERMINED even while noting that the chain rounds answer it.
quote: D4 vs C2 (Luke 2:48-49): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: The phrase 'a single verse does not state a link or its contrary' could mean only an explicit non-statement is forbidden, or it could mean any single-verse insufficiency; the judge text treats a single-verse exchange as UNDERDETERMINED despite chain answers.
why: By labeling the single-verse Luke 2:48-49 point UNDERDETERMINED, the judge uses the insufficiency of that verse as a ground, contrary to K-S2.
